column1: # Outputs later analysis depends on. Enforced by scripts/retention_guard.py:
#   * at every snakemake parse (dry runs included), the workflow refuses to
#     start if a rule declares one of these temp(), or a rule's shell deletes
#     one it does not itself produce;
#   * after every run, a ledger (data/.retention_ledger.tsv) records each one
#     that exists and reports any recorded file that has since disappeared;
#   * scripts/cleanup_intermediates.sh refuses to delete any of them.
# Why this exists (2026-11-20): reads, fastp output, contigs.fasta and
# sorted.bam were reclaimed for every finished sample before per-contig
# coverage had been taken, and run_rdrpcatch/taxonomy_cleanup purged the
# six-frame translation the RdRp domain extraction needs. Recovering cost a
# full re-download of 96 runs. Reads and BAMs are deliberately NOT listed
# (terabytes): a rule that needs them must be a declared consumer of the
# temp() file so it runs before the file is reclaimed.
# Adding a downstream step that reads a per-sample file? Add the file here.
# Removing a line needs a reason in the commit message.
